# Vendored front-end files

Served locally so the display box needs no CDN at runtime.

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `gsap/gsap.min.js` | GSAP 3.12.5, `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js` | GreenSock Standard "no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `fonts/barlow-*.woff2` | Barlow 400/500/600/700, latin subset, `@fontsource/barlow@5.1.0` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |
| `fonts/barlow-condensed-*.woff2` | Barlow Condensed 600/700/800, latin subset, `@fontsource/barlow-condensed@5.1.0` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |

The latin subset covers å, ä, ö and é.
